items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I didn't get into Beethoven until much later, see, when I found out he was black.

ctx.x: The records with Bird. He was just superb on those.

Funky. People don't think of John Lewis as being funky, but he's very funky. Funny (inaudible) Well, we're still on the question of who influenced me, who my favorite musicians were. I didn't get into Beethoven until much later, see, when I found out he was black. See, I didn't know he was black, a black German. Everybody don't know that, so when I found out he was one of the first black men to play music, I started listening at him, and I didn't like his orchestral writing until the later things he did, opus…
